shots.label: PARTIDA REAL
shots.purpose: Hook: the black queen is attacked
shots.narration_es: La dama de Fischer estaba atacada. Y no la retiró.
shots.visual: Full 9:16 board position V-P1, c5 bishop to b6 queen emphasis; no portrait.
shots.risk: Caption must not imply sacrifice was forced.

shots.label: PARTIDA REAL
shots.purpose: Identify position and stakes without inventing intentions
shots.narration_es: El alfil blanco de c5 amenazaba la dama negra en b6.
shots.visual: Slow isolated highlight on c5 and b6, no extra legal move.

shots.label: PARTIDA REAL
shots.narration_es: Fischer jugó 17...Be6. Su alfil pasó a atacar el alfil de c4.
shots.visual: Move black bishop g4→e6. Maintain legible b6 queen.

shots.label: PARTIDA REAL
shots.narration_es: Byrne capturó la dama: 18.Bxb6. La partida no había terminado.
shots.visual: Move white bishop c5→b6, remove black queen; retain real marker.
shots.risk: Caption should not suggest game ended after queen capture.

shots.label: PARTIDA REAL
shots.purpose: Hold position to explain why the exchange is not the conclusion
shots.narration_es: La combinación continuó con nuevos ataques y capturas.
shots.visual: Hold V-REAL. No unverified move or future-board animation.
shots.risk: No engine evaluation or forced line asserted.

shots.label: MULTI_PHASE_EVENT_TRUTH
shots.purpose: Illustrate a clearly unplayed Qd8 alternative
shots.narration_es: ¿Y si hubiera jugado 17...Qd8? Es una alternativa no jugada.
shots.visual: First show explicit rewind to exact V-P1 with `REBOBINADO · PARTIDA REAL`; only after rewind completion switch to `HIPOTÉTICA · NO JUGADA`, then animate queen b6→d8 while that warning remains persistent.
shots.risk: Five-second rewind/branch/move segment has HIGH perceptual risk. No human test performed.

event_truth_sequence.release_condition: Rewind completes at exact V-P1 on MAIN.
Do not release during hypothetical branch.
Persist for every frame of unplayed 17...Qd8.

shots.label: REGRESO A LA PARTIDA REAL
shots.visual: Restore exact V-P1 board; remove hypothetical banner only after board restoration.
shots.risk: Two-second return may be too short for novice viewers.

event_truth_sequence.release_condition: Hypothetical warning may disappear only after exact V-P1 and MAIN context are restored.

shots.label: MULTI_PHASE_EVENT_TRUTH
shots.purpose: Bridge real line and show 25...Nxd1 with visible omission
shots.narration_es: Más tarde, 25...Nxd1 capturó la torre blanca en d1.
shots.caption_es: T08/T09: PARTIDA REAL → T10: SE OMITEN JUGADAS REALES · 14 medias jugadas → T11: PARTIDA REAL · 25...Nxd1
shots.visual: Replay T08 and T09 as REAL; then explicitly change overlay to `SE OMITEN JUGADAS REALES` for T10 (plies 36–49 inclusive, 14 half-moves); only after the ellipsis completes return to `PARTIDA REAL` and show 25...Nxd1. V-PRE-EV2 remains technical input, not a silently presented move.
shots.risk: Four semantic events within six seconds is UNTESTED and likely too dense. Requires longer edit trial.

shots.label: CIERRE EDITORIAL · LA PARTIDA CONTINÚA
shots.purpose: Close editorially without confusing 25...Nxd1 with game end
shots.narration_es: Y la partida siguió: este no fue su final.
shots.visual: Hold V-EV2, no fake mate scene or publication CTA.
shots.risk: Avoid misleading impression that the game ends at ply 50.
